name: Books-tab BI Window Coverage
description: In the /Books tab (49Financial + Inflection) the windowed advisor-summary metrics -- NNA, GRO (AUA growth %), New Clients, Rank -- must re-compute when the user changes the window in the 'Business Intelligence' panel. Today they do not: 49F covers QTD/YTD but 1Y/3Y/Max silently fall back to QTD, and Inflection's window selector does not drive these metrics at all. DE 0.4's root-cause analysis (the brief) found three distinct defects: (1) DATA -- platinum/firm/leaderboard.json emits only QTD/YTD/MAX windows (no 1Y, no 3Y); the gold leaderboard producers -- asymmetric architecture (49F fix: widen _LEADERBOARD_WINDOWS in data/black_diamond/scripts/gold/D_04.client_portal_summary.py; Inflection fix: data/orion/scripts/gold/INF_D_00c.portal_leaderboard.py _window_date_range; producer chain definitively traced by DS~C 2026-05-15, the DE 0.4 brief mis-traced it) hardcode the window set. (2) FE map bug -- ClientsTab.tsx PERIOD_TO_LB_WINDOW maps max to '3Y' (a typo; should be 'MAX', and MAX data already exists), and trailing_1y/trailing_3y point at window keys the data lacks, producing a silent QTD fallback. (3) FE Inflection gap -- Inflection renders InflectionInsightsPanel (its own internal window state) instead of FeeEfficiencyPanel, so BooksTab feePeriod is frozen at its default. Fix: a backend-independent FE window-coverage TO + a BE TO that emits 1Y/3Y windows from both orion gold leaderboard producers.
